messages:
mia: Heads-up — during the latest eval-run UI test, the scorecard skeleton uses aria-busy and also fires an aria-live alert saying "Loading results" repeatedly when diffs stream in. Screenreader users are getting a lot of noise. /cc @samir @olivia

samir: Yikes. Do you have repro steps or a recording? Which component (skeleton vs placeholder)?

design-bot: Accessibility scan attached: https://redwood.link/att/xyz — flagged multiple live-region updates and focus hints.

mia: Repro: open an eval run -> pick a regression diff -> rapidly expand examples. Happens on Chrome+NVDA and Safari+VoiceOver. I can record a short clip.

olivia: Thanks. Flagging priority — this could be a blocking UX for customers relying on screen readers. Can we get a quick mitigation? @jasper

jasper: Probable root cause: live region updates on each item render. Quick wins: switch aria-live to polite, debounce announcements, and use a single announcer node. Example pseudo-patch:
```
// pseudo-js
const announcer = document.getElementById('sr-announcer');
const announce = debounce(msg => announcer.textContent = msg, 700);
announce('New results available');
```

samir: Don't set role=status on each diff. Use one offscreen element: role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true". Batch updates so we only announce after a group finishes. Also check we don't programmatically move focus.

aisha: Can we ship a hotfix behind a feature flag? If it's a small change, let's prioritize in the next patch to hosted. Need QA steps, regression checklist, and rollback plan.

mia: I'll upload the repro clip + add NVDA and VoiceOver acceptance criteria to the ticket. Also will add an automated spot-check to the eval test-suite so it doesn't regress.

olivia: UX copy tweak suggestion: use "New results available" instead of "Loading results" so it's less repetitive and clearer for SR users. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

jasper: Fine by me. I'll open a PR with the announcer change + unit and e2e a11y check. ETA: EOD. Will gate behind ff_a11y_live_region fix flag.

samir: Also add a short note in the scorecard help tooltip describing live updates and keyboard tips. Small doc update for accessibility guide would help.

aisha: Great. Mia, please add owners and the rollout plan to the ticket. I'll coordinate release notes and the feature flag rollout in the console. :rocket:
